_comment: Sends recorded by a human. The pipeline never writes a send here; it only records one that already happened. EMPTY ON PURPOSE as of 2026-09-21: nothing has been sent. The mechanism was exercised end-to-end during Round 14 and the demonstration record was removed, because a fake send would corrupt the one measurement this file exists to keep.
mechanism: CLI: `01_source.py sent --key K --from ADDR [--at ISO]` and `01_source.py outcome --key K --url URL [--at ISO]`. The file is the durable store; the commands are the doors. They validate, they are idempotent on the item key, and the file stays hand-editable if a correction is needed.
